letterText:
My dear colleagues,

I must beg your pardon for arriving late to the field this morning. A duty of the tenderer sort detained me upon the road, for I was charged with delivering the young ones safely to their summer encampment, and could not in good conscience abandon that small caravan before its journey's end.

Yet I am glad to report that the repairs are at last complete. Even now I entrust them to the courier, and the pull request rides forth to meet you under its own colors.

I remain, though tardy, ever devoted to the cause.
dateLine: Written upon the Road, this 30th day of June
signature: Your obedient & belatedly arrived servant, J.
title: A Letter from the Front
